name: Angel Love
source:
Human/Clone

The heroine who is a clone of someone from the past.

Angel is a certified nurse for cyborgs and wishes the best for them, including helping her friends Lien and Kolei with their personal issues.

Well meaning and committed, Angel won’t stop until her friends are finally happy.

[From [url=http://altabestudio.com/works/ea-pinocchio/]official site[/url]]
